description: One supplier's record: contracts won, buyers, totals, exclusions and grants, with the source and licence. Needs an Enterprise Data key: X-API-Key header on the MCP request (https://assay-systems.com/api-key/#data).

country.description: Two-letter country code in lower case, e.g. ca, us, gb, ua. assay_countries lists them.

id.description: Record id as given by assay_search (the part after the country in the endpoint).
